cns.text: Young Count Brago sees the potential of the City, and he and Selvala work inseparably to build a coalition and draft the Charter that forges Paliano.
Three years into his reign Brago is diagnosed with an incurable hereditary illness, and he and Selvala reluctantly agree to the priests' magical treatments.
Years later, Selvala tells the withered king he is no longer the king she remembers, and Brago, who cannot die naturally, begs her to kill him; she forgives him and stabs him through the heart.
Afterwards Brago's spirit appears in a blue mist and orders the Custodi to announce that the king has risen, and they hail him as King Eternal.
